title: Parent-preserving causal midpoint adaptation with proof-bounded expert mixing

authorship.claim_boundary: A Gamma-authored causal adaptation child of an attributed external parent

objective.claim: A bounded adapted expert can improve second-half coding while the authoritative parent state remains unchanged by the expert and protected by a causal mixture.
not_claimed: archive gain before an exact finite-coder receipt
a one-bit bound for the quantized implementation unless separately proved
Gamma authorship of the parent codec

required_facts: integer probability identity against the qualified parent
process-tree peak at or below 9765625 KiB
sufficient measured headroom for fork state
P and K are probability- and state-identical
F beats P on an actual finite archive
F beats the causally misaligned control
J retains at least 80 percent of F gross archive gain
J rejoins the untouched parent at byte 64
encoder and decoder weight traces are identical
ideal-theory and finite-coder claim scopes are separated

block_contract.activation_point: after ordinary parent processing of byte 31 and before prediction of byte 32
block_contract.join_point: after ordinary parent processing of byte 63 and before prediction of the next block
block_contract.parent_update_cadence: unchanged at every original call site

authoritative_parent.role: the only state allowed to survive the join
authoritative_parent.transition: ordinary parent transition and ordinary persistent learning only

adapted_expert.origin: exact midpoint snapshot of every parent state component whose future transition can differ
adapted_expert.transition: frozen midpoint treatment followed by ordinary decoded-symbol transitions within bytes 32 through 63
adapted_expert.join_action: discard without copying any value into the authoritative parent

state_contract.sharing_rule: Mutable state may be shared only when a frozen dependency proof establishes that its update is prediction-independent and byte-identical in both branches; otherwise it is duplicated.
state_contract.join_identity_requirement: After join, every state capable of affecting future parent probabilities equals a P-only execution at the same boundary.
state_contract.continuity_rule: Coder state, emitted payload, mixed probability history, and the global mixture posterior are never rewound or replaced by P-only values at join; only the authoritative predictor state rejoins P.

prediction_contract.parent_probability: exact parent integer count p_count over coder scale C
prediction_contract.expert_probability: exact adapted-branch integer count d_count over the same coder scale C
prediction_contract.mixture: inherit the frozen integer arithmetic, normalization, clipping, update, and serialization rules from gamma_safe_mix_v1
prediction_contract.posterior_scope: one global causal parent-versus-adapted posterior across the stream
prediction_contract.posterior_update_point: after the decoded bit is known to both encoder and decoder
prediction_contract.expert_availability: the adapted expert sleeps outside bytes 32 through 63
prediction_contract.coder_input: the exact finite integer mixture count after the inherited deterministic quantizer
prediction_contract.theorem_scope: The ideal Bayesian log-loss inequality applies only to the ideal real-valued mixture. Any finite-integer regret statement requires a separate proof; archive measurements remain authoritative.

K.description: Performs snapshot, fork bookkeeping, state hashing, and sleeping-expert bookkeeping but injects no update and supplies a parent-identical expert
K.required_identity: probabilities, states, payload, archive, and inverse exactly equal P

D.description: Raw aligned adapted fork without SAFE-MIX
D.purpose: measure the specialist independently of mixture protection

M.description: Aligned adapted fork combined with the parent through gamma_safe_mix_v1

R.description: Matched-norm random-direction fork combined through the identical mixture machinery
R.purpose: separate causal learning direction from generic perturbation

S.description: Frozen causally misaligned first-half association with otherwise identical fork and mixture machinery

control_requirements: P equals K before any treatment comparison
M must beat P on an actual finite archive
D must establish that the adapted expert itself carries value
M must beat or safely contain D on preregistered transfer populations
M must beat R to support a gradient-alignment claim
M must beat S to support a causal-association claim
all arms use the same source revision, frontend, coder, corpus bytes, compiler, and accounting boundary

resource_contract.forbidden_shortcut: No full duplicate of prediction-independent large tables without a measured and justified state dependency.

required: complete counted score at or below 105000000 bytes
memory, disk, runtime, and cleanup receipts pass

economics.required_gain_source: computed from measured parent counted score, maximum added package, frozen reserve, and realized exact package savings
economics.rule: Target debt must never be copied into an expected-savings field.

decision_router.dependency_failure: remain dormant or retire according to the dependency receipt
decision_router.M_better_than_P_but_not_R: retain only a generic specialist-mixture observation; reject causal-gradient claim
decision_router.M_positive_but_memory_fail: authorize one memory-compilation successor; no compression promotion
decision_router.M_transfer_pass: promote through the frozen archive ladder
decision_router.M_and_WIKI_PDA_independently_pass: authorize one fresh joint PDA-conditioned SAFE-MIDAS contract

immutability.change_after_observation: requires a new candidate identifier and complete joint replay

reason_execution_is_forbidden: Arm B is active and activation dependencies are not terminally passed.
